card.name: Monitoring instructions in warnings sections
card.fires_on: Words right after 'Monitor' or 'Laboratory' in warnings text, such as 'patients' or 'Tests', and a few words inside lab or blood-pressure terms. It fires where a monitoring instruction is about to name what to check.

modes.label: Laboratory Tests heading
modes.description: The word 'Tests' in a 'Laboratory Tests' section heading.

modes.label: The phrase "Monitor patients for"
modes.description: The word 'patients' straight after 'Monitor' in an instruction to watch for new symptoms.

modes.label: Inside lab or vital-sign terms
modes.description: A word inside a lab list or a measurement term, just before the closing part.
